subject: [PATCH 3/3] zstd: probe the CPU for BMI2 support only once

2026-08-26.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the ZSTD_cpuSupportsBmi2() function by caching its result instead of probing the CPU for BMI2 support every time it's called. This is done to reduce the overhead of serializing CPUID instructions, which can be expensive especially in busy workloads or under KVM. The cache is stored as a single int with a negative sentinel value and is accessed using READ_ONCE() and WRITE_ONCE() macros to ensure thread safety.
